verdict.rationale: Square documents an official remote MCP server (mcp.squareup.com) plus an open-source local MCP server (square-mcp-server), with documented OAuth login, scoped permissions, and setup instructions for clients like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf; a live probe confirms the remote server is real and OAuth-gated per MCP spec. This clearly satisfies connecting an agent via an official MCP server. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) hands-on validation of the MCP server's reliability beyond the vendor docs and probes.
